title: XROS 5 Kit – 2ml
description:
VAPORESSO XROS 5 POD KIT

The VAPORESSO XROS 5 POD KIT is an MTL device built to last. Powered by COREX 3.0 Tech, it provides users with a more constant, stable and richer aroma reproduction, delicate flavor, and smoother vaping experience. It has a 1500mAh battery and supports 3A Super charging. Adjustable power and airflow allow for customization, and the 0.88-inch OLED display with six different colorful themes provides users with fun interactive enjoyment.

Features

- 0.88-inch OLED Screen

- Adjustable Power & Airflow

- Corex 3.0 Tech

- XROS Series Pods Compatible

Specifications

- Dimensions: 120*24.5*14.5mm

- Output Power: 30W Max

- Pod Capacity: 2mL

- Battery Capacity: 1500mAh

- Charging: Type-C, 3A

- 1x VAPORESSO XROS 5 POD

Package List

- 1x VAPORESSO XROS REPLACEMENT POD (4 PACK) -0.6OHM (Pre-installed)

- 1x VAPORESSO XROS REPLACEMENT POD (4 PACK) -0.8OHM (In box)

- 1x Type-C Charging Cable

- 1x Reminder Card

- 1x User Manual & Warranty Card
